title: What the launcher installed of one vendor component (<game>/kiln/vendor/<vendor>/<version>/kiln-vendor.json), format 1
description: Written by the launcher (kiln_manage::vendor) after every file of the component was downloaded and its size and SHA-256 matched the launcher's manifest; written last, atomically, so a folder without it is not complete and is not used. Read by the launcher and, from phase B, by Kiln in the game, which checks each file's SHA-256 again (and against the hashes it was built with) before it loads it, and loads it by its full path. docs/kiln/launcher/contracts.md, "Vendor files".

version.description: The vendor's version: the folder's name.

sha256.description: The licence text the player agreed to before this download.
